name: Location contradiction (FASTag/telematics)
description: A FASTag or parking event within ±90 min of the reported time is more than 25 km from the reported location, or a toll on the claimed route is absent.
customer_safe_reason: We need to confirm where the vehicle was at the time of the incident.

name: Pre-existing damage
description: The damage assessment reports pre-existing damage with confidence ≥ 0.70 on a claimed part.
customer_safe_reason: We need a few more photos of the damaged area.

name: Narrative–damage inconsistency
description: Impact direction or severity contradicts the reported story (confidence ≥ 0.65).
customer_safe_reason: Could you describe how the incident happened in a little more detail?

name: Frequent claimant (IIB)
description: Two or more OD claims in the last 12 months across insurers.
customer_safe_reason: We need details of your recent claims history.

name: Early claim after inception / break-in
description: Incident within 30 days of policy start, or the policy was issued after a break in cover.
customer_safe_reason: We need your previous policy details.

name: Garage overquote
description: Garage quote 15–30% above the assessed estimate (5 pts, warn) or more than 30% (15 pts, fail).
customer_safe_reason: We are reviewing the repair estimate with your garage.

name: Organised network link
description: Phone, garage, surveyor or bank account shared with two or more other high-risk claims in 180 days.
customer_safe_reason: We need to verify a few contact details.

name: Vehicle blacklisted or reported stolen
description: Vahan or NCRB shows the vehicle as blacklisted or stolen. Hard stop.
customer_safe_reason: We need to verify your vehicle's registration details.

name: RC owner differs from policyholder
description: Owner name on RC does not match the policyholder (fuzzy ratio < 0.85) without a transfer record.
customer_safe_reason: Please share proof of vehicle ownership transfer.

name: Driving licence invalid
description: Licence expired on the incident date, or its class does not cover the vehicle.
customer_safe_reason: Please share a copy of the driver's valid licence.

name: Photo metadata mismatch
description: Photo EXIF time more than 24 h before the incident, or EXIF GPS more than 25 km from the reported location.
customer_safe_reason: We need a few fresh photos of the vehicle.

name: Late intimation
description: Reported more than 7 days after the incident.
customer_safe_reason: Please tell us why the claim was reported after a few days.

name: Commercial use of private vehicle
description: Evidence of commercial use of a privately registered vehicle.
customer_safe_reason: Please confirm how the vehicle is normally used.

name: Unwitnessed night single-vehicle accident
description: Between 23:00 and 05:00, no third party and no witness.
customer_safe_reason: If anyone saw the incident, please share their contact details.

name: Document tampering signs
description: The document check reports tampering indicators with confidence ≥ 0.7.
customer_safe_reason: Please upload a clearer copy of your documents.

name: Vehicle identity mismatch
description: Make/model or number plate in the photos does not match the policy, Vahan or RC record (confidence ≥ 0.75).
customer_safe_reason: Please share clearer photos showing the whole vehicle and number plate.

name: Different vehicles across photos
description: At least one photo appears to show a different vehicle from the others (confidence ≥ 0.75).
customer_safe_reason: Please share clearer photos showing the whole vehicle and number plate.

name: Vehicle detail unclear / colour mismatch
description: Colour differs from the registered colour, or make/model and plate are unclear on all photos.
customer_safe_reason: Please share clearer photos showing the whole vehicle and number plate.
